stemMd: Which Istanbul monument is associated with the sixteenth century rather than the sixth?
explanationMd: The Süleymaniye Mosque is a sixteenth-century work in Istanbul. Hagia Sophia is approximately a millennium older. Their presence in one city does not make their architectural periods identical.

distractorRationale.b: UNESCO dates Hagia Sophia to the sixth century.
distractorRationale.c: It is in Athens and dates to antiquity.
distractorRationale.a: It is a twentieth-century modernist work.
